commands.name: chat.list
commands.description: List the person's chats in Chat, newest first: id, title, when it started and last changed, and how many messages it holds.

commands.name: chat.read
commands.description: Read one chat by the id from chat.list: each question and answer, with the lookups Chat made for each answer.

commands.name: chat.open
commands.description: Bring Chat to the front with a new, empty chat. When `about` is given, the question box starts with that line (for example 'About this meeting [m1]: Vendor call, 24 Nov.') and the person types the question after it. Sends nothing to the model.

about.description: One line naming the mail, event, follow-up or meeting the question is about, with its id

commands.name: chat.ask
commands.description: Ask Chat a question in a new chat and get its answer. Chat looks things up in the person's Mail, Calendar, Follow-ups and Meetings with their commands and may save a draft, add or change an event, or add or close a follow-up when the question asks for that; it never sends or deletes. Needs an AI model on in NakliOS.

question.description: The question, in the person's words

about.description: Optional line naming the item the question is about

parity.stop: person: the person who started an answer stops it
